verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is itself an AI model, so a fair question is whether a user can hand tasks to it, and the evidence supports this only through the developer API. The docs cover thinking mode, first-class tool calling, use as a backend inside agents like Claude Code, OpenCode and Copilot, and a developer-preview DeepSeek Harness for agent builders. However, the evidence never shows a built-in end-user assistant you can delegate to directly, and one hands-on report says function calling produced duplicated and hallucinated calls, which weakens agentic delegation. Missing for 10: a documented first-party end-user assistant or chat surface for delegating tasks, in-product agent workflows beyond the API, and independent confirmation that tool use is reliable.
